name: At the Airport
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on at the airport — practice these key phrases out loud:
Where is the check-in counter for this airline?
Which gate does this flight depart from?
Is this flight on time, or has it been delayed?
Could you help me find my baggage claim?
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
